The camera wearer moves past several seated customers and approaches a man in a red shirt behind the checkout counter. He is roughly 1–2 meters ahead, facing the wearer, while the payment terminal is at the counter’s near-right edge and within the wearer’s reach. Nobody blocks the wearer’s path. This positioning makes the wearer the customer, so the appropriate next action is to insert their debit card and follow the terminal prompts.
